facts.fact: ANSSI's PKI Racine head Landry Kouadio Assi said on 11 November 2026 that the national root PKI is in use, by public bodies only, with phase 1 the systematic roll-out of e-signature, time-stamping and archiving across ministries.

CIV.note: No civil register to ID link stated; linkage of PKI to digital identity is a later phase.
Birth certificate signing is an illustration only; no civil register system stated.

facts.fact: The report says decrees of 2021 and 2024 created ANSSI-CI as the governance authority for cybersecurity, on the legal base of the 2013 cybersecurity laws.

CIV.note: Sovereignty is argued for the PKI root; no rule, hosting or contract term on state data stated.

facts.fact: The report says the 2013 cybersecurity laws, with the 2021 and 2024 decrees, give ANSSI the legal base to give probative force to secure electronic signatures.

CIV.note: No national ID system operation stated.
No register keyed on the ID number stated.
No civil registration office system stated.
